steps.note: Open the Single Stage create screen.
Enable floor quantity validation for the tenant.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Configure a reverse buy auction with rank strategy.
Select a reverse buy auction template so the product sheet is available.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Set the first row's delivery location.
Enter the invalid negative floor quantity.
Verify Procol immediately rejects the negative floor quantity.
